articles.title: Coinbase's weak quarter leaves Wall Street split on timing of a recovery
articles.snippet: Most analysts blamed a weak crypto market for Coinbase's earnings miss, though opinions diverged on when trading activity will recover.

articles.title: U.S. sanctions Iran-linked bitcoin insurance scheme for Strait of Hormuz ships
articles.snippet: The Treasury Department said the Hormuz Safe platform accepted bitcoin and other digital assets as part of an alleged sanctions workaround tied to IRGC-backed shipping controls.

articles.title: Bitcoin flat near $64,000 as Kospi's record 17% surge leaves crypto untouched
articles.snippet: Samsung and SK Hynix both jumped more than 23%. Bitcoin moved a fraction of a percent in the past 24 hours, and most majors are still lower on the week.

articles.title: Global banks test tokenized money for cross-border payments in $1 million BIS pilot
articles.snippet: Twenty-eight banks, including JPMorgan, Citi and UBS, moved real money across borders in a live test of blockchain-based settlement.

articles.title: Tether earns $1.5B in Q2 as US Treasury holdings fuel profits
articles.snippet: Tether’s reserve surplus grew to $4.11 billion in the second quarter as USDT supply rose despite a weaker stablecoin market and continued pressure across the crypto sector.
